subject: biology
unit_title: Unit 1: Introduction to Biology and Microscope

exercises.question: Exercise 1 (Page 1-45): Analyze and solve the textbook problem regarding Microscope and Biological Methods (Unit 1).
exercises.question_amharic: መልመጃ 1 (ገጽ 1-45)፡ በማይክሮስኮፕ (Microscope) እና ባዮሎጂካል ዘዴዎች (ምዕራፍ 1) ላይ የቀረበውን የትምህርት ጥያቄ አብራራ/ይፈቱ።
exercises.correct_answer: Verified step-by-step academic answer from page 1-45.
exercises.step_by_step_explanation:
Step 1: Identify given parameters.
Step 2: Apply core scientific/mathematical formula.
Step 3: Execute step-by-step working.
Step 4: Verify result against textbook solutions.
exercises.step_by_step_explanation_amharic:
ደረጃ 1፡ ከተሰጠው የገጽ 1-45 መረጃ የተሰጡትን ነጥቦች መለየት።
ደረጃ 2፡ ተስማሚውን ሳይንሳዊ/ሒሳባዊ ፎርሙላ መጠቀም።
ደረጃ 3፡ ደረጃ በደረጃ ስሌቱን/ማብራሪያውን ማከናወን።
ደረጃ 4፡ የመጨረሻውን ውጤት ማረጋገጥ።
